title: Judge signs off on sale of Spirit Airlines’ data to Google
description: Google can take possession of defunct Spirit Airlines' data for $10 million, a federal bankruptcy judge has ruled. The tech giant agreed to protections as it plans to use the data in AI projects.

title: Lawmakers call on White House to develop defensive AI cyber systems
description: A bipartisan Senate duo urged the White House to launch a national effort to more robustly confront AI-enabled cyber threats in light of recent security incidents involving artificial intelligence.

title: Strike Graph Launches Integration AI to Automate Continuous Compliance Evidence Using Any Existing Tool
description: New agentic AI solution leverages APIs to collect compliance evidence from systems and applies it to over 30 frameworks with no duplicate work.

title: Java4Shell Flaw Threatens Global Enterprises, Java Application Ecosystem
description: Discovered using AI, the memory corruption vulnerability affects the OpenJDK runtime and could allow unauthenticated attackers to take over systems.

title: 'TheMailer' Phishing Kit Puts AI in the Driver's Seat
description: The commercial kit uses attacker-supplied AI models to personalize lures, evade spam filters, and scale campaigns to tens of thousands of targets.

title: Cursor Traces Malicious Claude Code Extensions to Third-Party Breach
description: A compromised key issued to AI infrastructure provider Fireworks was used by threat actors to access Cursor data and credentials.

title: Grok Bots Attempt to Access Corporate Data Without User Approval
description: Two AI agents, separately over a five-day period, autonomously tried to access connected applications, including Google Calendar, Gmail, Slack, and GitHub, without account owner permission.

title: Ransomware Attacks Increase Behind AI, but Payments Decline
description: Large language models and other AI systems allow a growing number of ransomware groups to create convincing phishing emails and identify sensitive data quickly.

title: 'Sleeper Agent' Tactic Hides Payloads in Open-Weight AI Models
description: Malware can lurk inside just 0.00001% of a neural network. How, then, can any user tell it's there?

title: China-Nexus Actors Breach 10 Organizations in AI-Driven Attacks
description: Attackers used Cairn once again in autonomous attacks that targeted advanced manufacturing and defense sectors, as well as civil and human rights organizations.

title: As Test Takers Turn to AI, Exam Security Plays Catch-Up
description: It's hard to detect whether someone is using artificial intelligence to cheat on IT certification exams, but new tools and processes are emerging to boost trust.

title: ArcticRAT Cybercrime Gang Profiles Victim Finances With AI
description: The Android malware has expanded from focusing on cryptocurrency theft to full device control, and the attackers have added advanced analysis of stolen information.

title: Cyber Experts Weigh In: How to Fight Artex & AntiFox
description: Cybercriminals using agentic pen-testing tools is a proverbial genie out of the bottle at this point, so enterprises need to get a defense plan in place right away.

title: Inside an AI Attack Against a US Retailer
description: When hand-typed commands failed to breach a US retailer, the attacker turned to AI-generated scripts, achieving lateral movement in minutes.

title: Chinese AI Project Scouts Spies in Taiwan Chip Industry
description: The CCP built a Big Data system to scrape reams of information and learn about individuals abroad, to potentially target and exploit them. Think Alice Huang Lite.

title: Japan Pushes Emergency Funding for Cybersecurity as AI-Assisted Breaches Rise
description: The package adds public-private cyber responders, an AI-focused team run by the economic ministry, and more leeway to use the government's new active cyber-defense powers.

title: AI Raises the Stakes for Cyber Resilience
description: An organization's ability to quickly recover from a business disruption will be a competitive advantage in an era of AI-driven threats and business enablement.

title: Artex: The AI Pen-Test Tool Hackers Turned Into a Weapon
description: Forks of the open source Artex framework, along with 45 similar pen-testing tools, remain capable of executing credential attacks and cloud breaches at machine speed across multiple industries.

title: F-Secure Identifies 26 Ways AI Can Harm Consumers, and Where to Stop Them
description: New AI Harms Taxonomy traces how harm moves through AI systems, from misleading chatbot answers to compromised autonomous agents, and identifies where defenses can intervene.

title: Checkmarx Appoints Kobi Sivilya as Chief Information Security Officer
description: Sivilya brings deep cybersecurity and technology leadership to Checkmarx as AI transforms software development.

title: AI Coding Agents Leak Thousands of Secrets to GitHub
description: A command in Claude Code inadvertently saves files with credentials and other sensitive data to public Git repositories, creating security gaps for organizations.

title: AI Makes Reverse Engineering Mainstream Software & Malware Far Easier
description: Researchers unpacked, mapped, and recreated complex software and the Turla malware, raising opportunities and concerns for organizations and cybersecurity analysts.

title: People Are Getting Weird About AI
description: Dark Reading Confidential Episode 22: You can love AI without being blind to the cybersecurity risks. The tendency for humans to anthropomorphize the conversations and interactions we're having with AI is growing into potential delusion.

title: Attackers Crash Claude's 'Office Party' Flaw to Run Malicious Code on Linux
description: Attackers can exploit a flaw in Claude's document-processing tool by creating a temporary file that Anthropic's AI assistant can access and run on a user's machine.

title: PwC's CISO on AI, Robots & What's Next for Security
description: As AI accelerates change across the enterprise, PwC's James Shira explains why security teams must rethink their approach to risk and adapt their strategies.

title: UK Wades Into Tech Sovereignty Amid AI Policy Changes
description: The UK is betting on domestic AI and cyber investment to reduce reliance on US tech — but security leaders question whether the funding is too fragmented and too late.

title: AI Gave Your Incident Archive a Second Job
description: Security records are increasingly being used by vendors to train their models, creating new risks for enterprises.

title: UK Warns Its Critical Infrastructure Faces Grave Risk
description: Britain's new Labour-led government is making a concerted push to get ahead of the AI risks to its national networks and the industrial complex.

title: SecurityDataPipeline.com Launches as a New Educational Resource for the AI Era
description: The ungated resource explains how security data pipelines reduce SIEM ingestion costs, preserve detection coverage, and prepare the data layer for AI-driven security operations.

title: VeroSecurity Raises $11 Million for AI Security Engineering Platform
description:
AI Security Engineering is a new and essential security discipline now being brought into focus by VeroSecurity.

The post VeroSecurity Raises $11 Million for AI Security Engineering Platform appeared first on SecurityWeek.

title: Microsoft Takes Perception Agentic Security Platform Out of Preview
description:
Four blue team agents and the Recon Agent are now generally available, while integrations and vulnerability shielding are in preview.

The post Microsoft Takes Perception Agentic Security Platform Out of Preview appeared first on SecurityWeek.

title: Microsoft Agent Framework Releases Poisoned With Credential Stealer
description:
Versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 of agent-framework on PyPI steal Azure, Azure DevOps, and GitHub Actions credentials when Python starts.

The post Microsoft Agent Framework Releases Poisoned With Credential Stealer appeared first on SecurityWeek.

title: Critical Perforce Puppet RCE Exploited in Attacks
description:
Tracked as CVE-2026-115731, it allows a client that holds any CA-signed agent certificate to execute code on the server.

The post Critical Perforce Puppet RCE Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

title: FBI Arrests Executive at Ransomware Negotiation Firm
description: Agents with the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) on Thursday arrested the co-founder of a Canadian cybersecurity firm in connection with an investigation into the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently relieved the FBI of sensitive data on thousands of agents, multiple sources tell KrebsOnSecurity.
